arcs.title: The Subcommittee's Jurisdiction Problem
arcs.summary: Day 2: The Subcommittee dispatched a four-person mapping party, led by a supervisor named Cresswell, who could not locate the spur. They filed an incident report describing the terrain as uncooperative and formally requested that Christine and Steve provide precise coordinates, an approach line, and a statutory declaration. Christine has received the memo and placed it on the kitchen table next to the sketch. She has not replied. Day 3 should escalate the Subcommittee's overreach further — perhaps Cresswell requests a second attempt with Christine present to 'guide' the party, or the Subcommittee votes to assign the Room a provisional eleven-digit number regardless of whether it has been located. Christine's patience may begin to have a shape that resembles a decision.
